item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a clean 2024 example of AMLO publicly admitting an economic-policy mistake and reversing course because new evidence changed his view. The positive side is mostly continuity, technocratic staffing, and external validation. The negative side is stronger on slogan-based explanation, ideological scapegoating of “neoliberalism,” claims of corruption savings, and politically timed transfers than on outright policy collapse.","evidence":[{"title":"Mexico: 2024 Article IV Consultation and Review Under the Flexible Credit Line Arrangement","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-11-01","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/11/01/mexico-2024-article-iv-consultation-and-review-under-the-flexible-credit-line-arrangement-556997","summary":"The IMF said Mexico still qualified for the precautionary credit line because its macro frameworks, policy implementation record, and fundamentals were very strong, while also calling for gradual monetary normalization and a medium-term fiscal strategy. That is denial/deflection more than correction.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3"]},{"title":"Combate a la corrupción genera ahorros y permite distribución justa de la riqueza: presidente","publisher":"Presidencia de México","date":"2024-07-08","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/combate-a-la-corrupcion-genera-ahorros-y-permite-distribucion-justa-de-la-riqueza-presidente/","summary":"He claimed anti-corruption generated huge fiscal savings and financed welfare and infrastructure, but the argument is mostly slogan-like and self-validating rather than an explicit response to evidence of policy failure.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.5"]},{"title":"Economía Moral es mejor que el neoliberalismo: presidente; fortaleza del peso y reducción de la pobreza lo demuestran, afirma","publisher":"Presidencia de México","date":"2024-03-27","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/economia-moral-es-mejor-que-el-neoliberalismo-presidente-fortaleza-del-peso-y-reduccion-de-la-pobreza-lo-demuestran-afirma/","summary":"AMLO tied economic success to rejecting neoliberalism and to broad claims about poverty and peso strength, which is ideological framing rather than iterative correction of policy errors.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3"]},{"title":"Evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral","publisher":"Programas para el Bienestar","date":"2024-03-18","url":"https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/","summary":"The government said welfare payments were advanced before the electoral blackout and warned against vote-buying.
